ocl:
context Payment
inv: self.isProcessed implies self.loan <> null

context Payment
inv: self.isProcessed implies self.fine <> null

context Fine
inv: ((self.loan.member = self.member) and (self.member.oclIsTypeOf(Member))) and (self.amount.abs() <= 1)

context Payment
inv: (self.loan.fine = self.fine) and (self.timestamp <> '' and self.timestamp.size() > 0)

context Copy
inv: (self.loans->any(x | x.startDate <> '') <> null) and (self.barcode.size() = 8)

context Copy
inv: self.reservations->size() >= 1 and self.reservations->size() <= 2

context Book
inv: (self.pages.abs() <= 6) and (self.authors->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null)

context Book
inv: (self.publishYear mod 2 = 0) and (self.authors->collect(x | x.books)->size() >= 2)

context Reservation
inv: self.requestDate <> null implies self.expiryDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.returnDate <> null and self.startDate <> null

context Reservation
inv: self.expiryDate <> null implies self.requestDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.dueDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.returnDate <> null

context Loan
inv: self.startDate <> null and self.dueDate <> null and self.returnDate <> null

context Category
inv: (self.books->any(x | x.publishYear < 100) <> null) and (self.books->size() <= 3)

context Fine
inv: ((self.payments->collect(x | x.amount)->sum() >= 4) and (self.reason.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not((self.payments->collect(x | x.amount)->sum() >= 4) and (self.reason.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Book
inv: ((self.publishYear < 10) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.requestDate <> ''))) and (self.publishYear > 15)

context Fine
inv: ((self.amount < 1000) and (self.payments->forAll(v | v.amount < 50))) and (self.amount > 1005)

context Reservation
inv: (not(self.expiryDate <> null and self.requestDate <> null)) and (not(not(self.expiryDate <> null and self.requestDate <> null)))

context Author
inv: (self.books->size() >= 3 and self.books->size() <= 3) and (self.books->size() < 3)

context Fine
inv: ((self.amount >= 2) and (self.payments->forAll(v | v.amount >= 2))) and (self.amount < 2)

context Copy
inv: (self.reservations->forAll(x | x.requestDate <> '')) and (self.reservations->exists(x | not(x.requestDate <> '')))

context Branch
inv: (self.manager <> null) and (not(self.manager <> null))

context Author
inv: (self.books->select(x | x.pages > 1)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.books->select(x | x.pages > 1)->size() >= 1))

context Reservation
inv: (self.copy.book = self.book) and (not(self.copy.book = self.book))

context Branch
inv: ((self.address.branch.code <> '') and (self.name.size() >= 8 implies self.name.substring(1, 8) = 'AB')) and (not((self.address.branch.code <> '') and (self.name.size() >= 8 implies self.name.substring(1, 8) = 'AB')))
